# IMatch.AllowsFreezingBots property

Whether the game offers to freeze the bots once no player is left in a round of an offline match. True by default. The offer freezes every bot but the front one for 10 seconds, so the round ends sooner.

```csharp
public bool AllowsFreezingBots { get; set; }
```

## Remarks

The offer lasts until the end of the round, even if a player comes back into it. Turning this off withdraws the offer and hides its message.
